newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Rwanda tribunal delays joint genocide trial.
newsitem.headline: Rwanda tribunal delays joint genocide trial.

text.p: A U.N. tribunal delayed on Wednesday the start of a joint trial for two Rwandans accused of genocide and crimes against humanity in the mass slaughter in Rwanda in 1994.
The International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda in the Tanzanian town of Arusha said it would decide on Thursday wehther to start the joint trial of Clement Kayishema and Obed Ruzindana.
Kayishema and Ruzindana were brought into court on Wednesday but the three-judge panel said it needed to meet on Thursday to decide if the defence needed more time to read revised charges.
Both men are accused of organising and involvement in massacres in western Rwanda during the 1994 genocide of an estimated 800,000 minority Tutsis and moderate Hutus by troops, militiamen and mobs.
